200.description: The running version, the latest release and whether an update is available

description:
Compares the running version with the latest NPMpro release on GitHub. The answer is cached for one hour (six minutes after a failed lookup). When GitHub cannot be reached and nothing is cached, `latest` is `unknown` and `update_available` is false. Only release builds are ever reported as outdated.

Needs: a signed-in user (a session or an API token)
